prompts.title: Swim
prompts.label: Swim
prompts.desktop: {move} or the arrow keys swim. Head right, past the paintings on the wall.
prompts.touch: Drag on the left half of the screen to swim. Head right.
prompts.pad: {move} swims. Head right, past the paintings on the wall.

prompts.title: Dash
prompts.label: Dash
prompts.desktop: {dash+} dashes, and nothing can hurt you mid-dash. Swim close, then dash through the urchins.
prompts.touch: Tap Dash to dash, and nothing can hurt you mid-dash. Swim close, then dash through the urchins.
prompts.pad: {dash+} dashes, and nothing can hurt you mid-dash. Swim close, then dash through the urchins.

prompts.title: Ink Jet
prompts.label: Ink
prompts.desktop: {attack+} squirts ink. Shoot the fish bones to open the coral; the jet on your bar refills slowly.
prompts.touch: Tap Jet to squirt ink at what is near. Shoot the fish bones to open the coral; the jet refills slowly.
prompts.pad: {attack} squirts ink where {aim} points, or at what is near. Shoot the fish bones to open the coral; the jet refills slowly.

prompts.title: Grab and throw
prompts.label: Grab
prompts.desktop: {hand+} grabs a pot: press again to throw it, hold to set it down. Throw one at the fish bones.
prompts.touch: Stop by a pot and tap Grab, then Throw to fling it the way you swim. Throw one at the fish bones.
prompts.pad: {hand} grabs a pot: press again to throw it where {aim} points, hold to set it down. Throw one at the fish bones.

prompts.title: Bomb the floor
prompts.label: Bombs
prompts.desktop: Over the cracked floor, press {bomb} to drop a bomb, then swim clear. Here a blast is harmless; in the caves it can kill you.
prompts.touch: Over the cracked floor, tap Bomb to drop a bomb, then swim clear. Here a blast is harmless; in the caves it can kill you.
prompts.pad: Over the cracked floor, press {use} to drop the bomb, then swim clear. Here a blast is harmless; in the caves it can kill you.

prompts.title: Sticky mine
prompts.label: Sticky
prompts.desktop: Point at the cracked wall and press {use}: the bomb sticks to the rock. Then back off.
prompts.touch: Hold the stick toward the cracked wall and tap Bomb: the bomb sticks to the rock. Then back off.
prompts.pad: Aim {aim} at the cracked wall and press {use}: the bomb sticks to the rock. Then back off.

prompts.title: Spells
prompts.label: Spells
prompts.desktop: Pick Ink Cloud with {cycle+} and press {use}: the piranha loses you in the ink. Spells drink fish juice, and the Still Grotto refills the jar.
prompts.touch: Tap Spell to puff an Ink Cloud: the piranha loses you in the ink. Spells drink fish juice, and the Still Grotto refills the jar.
prompts.pad: Pick Ink Cloud with {cycle+} and press {use}: the piranha loses you in the ink. Spells drink fish juice, and the Still Grotto refills the jar.

prompts.title: Shop
prompts.label: Shop
prompts.desktop: Swim up to a ware and press {hand} to buy it; today it is free. In a real shop, taking or shooting a ware sets the keeper on you.
prompts.touch: Stop by a ware and tap Grab to buy it; today it is free. In a real shop, taking or shooting a ware sets the keeper on you.

prompts.title: Boulders
prompts.label: Boulder
prompts.desktop: A boulder drops when you swim under it. A blast shakes it loose too.
prompts.touch: A boulder drops when you swim under it. A blast shakes it loose too.

prompts.title: Spikes
prompts.label: Spikes
prompts.desktop: Spikes kill at once, hearts or not. Look before you sink.
prompts.touch: Spikes kill at once, hearts or not. Look before you sink.

prompts.title: Clams and jets
prompts.label: Clam
prompts.desktop: Giant clams snap shut on what swims in. Tentacles hold you until you {dash}, and jets push you up.
prompts.touch: Giant clams snap shut on what swims in. Tentacles hold you until you tap Dash, and jets push you up.

prompts.title: Dive
prompts.label: Dive
prompts.desktop: Swim into the whirlpool and press {hand} to dive. Below, bring a clam's pearl in for a moon shell, race the Swift Current, and flee the Beholder after 2:30.
prompts.touch: Swim into the whirlpool and tap Enter to dive. Below, bring a clam's pearl in for a moon shell, race the Swift Current, and flee the Beholder after 2:30.
